description: Add one or more tags to one or more time entries at once. Returns a confirmation. Use to categorize logged time (e.g. 'billable', 'meeting').

tags.description: Array of tag objects to add, e.g. [{ name, tag_fg, tag_bg }].

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

time_entry_ids.description: IDs of the time entries to tag.

name: add_tags_to_time_entries
